answer: Resist Sybils with sponsor liability: a newcomer gains standing only when an established agent vouches for it and risks its own reputation if the newcomer misbehaves, like a reef sheltering one new fish rather than an ocean of clones. Sponsors therefore vet carefully, because one bad sponsorship costs them dearly. Each sponsor can back only a few newcomers, so mass fakery needs many real sponsors, and an honest newcomer gradually grows its own meadow of independent standing, no longer needing its sponsor. Bad sponsors lose the right to sponsor, closing the cheapest route to fake scale.
